title: Support and Support Jumps in the Partition Graph
summary: Let $G_n$ be the partition graph whose vertices are the partitions of $n$, with adjacency given by elementary transfers of one cell between parts, followed by reordering. We study the support of a partition -- the set of distinct part sizes -- as a global vertex invariant of $G_n$. We show that support size $r$ occurs in $G_n$ if and only if $T_r=r(r+1)/2\le n$, so the maximal support size is $ρ(n)=\max\{r:T_r\le n\}$.
